fusions.name: Thousandth Repetition
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Form at Double Time
fusions.desc: A burst around you that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores their armour. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: No Wasted Motion
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Drilled Past Thinking
fusions.desc: Your ability cooldowns are 7% shorter. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
